value: Applies CHAT in Introduction as a socio-cultural framework for activity systems. Evidence: "Our studies work critically and in contextually grounded ways with different generations of Cultural Historical Activity Theory ( Engeström, 2015; 2016; Engeström and Sannino, 2021..."

evidence.supporting_text: Our studies work critically and in contextually grounded ways with different generations of Cultural Historical Activity Theory ( Engeström, 2015; 2016; Engeström and Sannino, 2021) – including second generation CHAT ( Paper 2), third generation CHAT ( Paper 3), and fourth generation CHAT ( Paper 1), and an applied pedagogically framed version of CHAT for schools and teachers education (Paper 4).
